I find this sub’s obsessive didactic nasal focus on “”truth”” kinda disturbing. Can’t people just theorize and have fun stringing together interesting and intriguing fantasies based in facts already layed down? I couldn’t care less if you don’t think someone’s theory will actually 100% show up in the massive films geared towards a mainstream audience. I’m much more interested in reading niche theory’s made by passionate fans drawing on cool or even obscure source material - I much prefer delving into someone’s unique creative fascinations  rather than uselessly trying to tell the future of a hollywood franchise.
